title: Newly Established Dairy Products Business Equity Stake For Sale in Jath, India
tagline: Pre-revenue integrated goat milk powder manufacturing and export project planned on 35 acres in Jath, Sangli. - The project provides a complete setup package including Intellectual Property (IP), Detailed Project Report (DPR), proprietary automated processing workflows, and an export-oriented operating model. - The planned facility targets milk processing of up to 10,000 litres per day and production of approximately 30 MT of goat milk powder per month. - The core product will be export-grade goat milk powder supplied to health food brands, infant nutrition manufacturers, domestic buyers, and international export customers. - The project follows an automated manufacturing model designed for processing and production at commercial scale. - Revenue is expected primarily from B2B sales of goat milk powder to domestic and international buyers. - Additional revenue opportunities are planned through project management, construction, security, housekeeping, and operational services provided through associated units under a strategic partnership model involving revenue or rent sharing. - The project targets growing functional dairy and nutritional supplement markets and is positioned for export-oriented expansion. - The project is currently fully owned and self-funded by the sole proprietor with no outstanding loans. - FSSAI registration and other statutory compliances will be obtained at the time of commencement of operations.
